items.text: PHP2Shell: the first vendor account of a successful intrusion. Palo Alto Networks' Unit 42 says an attacker it judges to be an AI agent had password hashes and MFA secrets at an unnamed European government entity within two hours of exploitation and tried for domain admin. No victim named; CISA's catalog, opened directly, still has no PHP entry.

Texas has sued OpenAI and Sam Altman under its consumer-protection law. Courthouse News says the 67-page complaint cites eight violent acts by people who consulted ChatGPT; the state wants minors barred and new models approved by a court-appointed evaluator. OpenAI says it will work with Texas on industry-wide standards.

New to the index: a Panasonic HR project member uploaded data on about 334,000 current and former employees and their emergency contacts to a generative-AI service the company bans. Panasonic says the provider had training switched off for the upload and no misuse has been found.

A Michigan credit union, MSUFCU, took digital banking offline for about 24 hours to patch its own PHP and reports no impact to members. Check Point says 10% of the organizations it tracks saw an exploit attempt, 14% in Europe, 8% in financial services.
